title: Users
subtitle: Manage team members and their access.
tempPwDesc: Share this with the user through a secure channel. They must change it on first login. It is shown only once.
tempPwLockReset: The account login lock has been cleared.
mfaResetWarning: The user will need to enroll MFA again at their next sign-in. This action is recorded in the audit log.
tempPwSendEmail: Also send it to the user by email
tempPwEmailSent: Sent to the user by email.
tempPwEmailFailed: Email delivery failed — hand the password over manually.
rolesHint: No role selected = Others (no conversation routing, no role-gated screens).

presence.staleHint: Switched on, but the console has not been seen lately, so new escalations skip this person.

name: Name
nameHint: Shown in hand-over messages and notes, and to customers as the agent's name. Left blank, the console uses the words of the e-mail address instead.
tempPwError: Could not issue a temporary password.

roleNames.title: Role names
roleNames.intro: The names below appear in the Roles column, the invite form, the filters and the team table. Change them to the words your team uses, for example CS and SA.
roleNames.hint: A role you leave alone keeps its built-in name and is shown in each person's own console language. A name you type is shown as typed, in every language.
roleNames.saveError: Could not save the role names.
roleNames.errorDuplicate: Another role already has that name. Give each role its own name.
roleNames.errorBlank: A role name cannot be empty.
